snapshot.filter: not hidden, not halted, not cancelled, 64-hex moneroTxid, base58 mint; deduplicated by mint

rule: EVERY token launched through XMR20 (past and future) migrates from the legacy Monero format to the private format through the same path: asset id = asset::Id('uxmr20private'+mint), its own custody state at its real mint, its own cutover snapshot, exactly the legacy amount credited, no deposit fee, no second bridge tax. New launches are appended here (or registered at runtime with addAsset) — no per-token code. Inscription variants (inscriptionVersion 1/2/none; Solana network label 'mainnet-beta' or other; Monero network 'mainnet'; transfer tax 150 or 0 bps; bridge versions 1/2/3 or no Solana bridge) do not change the path: the cutover snapshot is produced by the legacy indexer that already parses every variant, keyed by mint + legacy owner output key + amount; the private asset id depends on the mint only. Tokens without a Solana bridge migrate to private tokens with no Solana redemption path (documented per token).
